description: Publishes a selected-field snapshot of active Oregon business registrations using only principal-place-of-business rows, preserving legal-entity versus assumed-business-name semantics, one-to-many address observations, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.oregon.gov metadata and tckn-sxa6 JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, duplicate source-row identity, source refresh drift, count mismatch, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: The selected-field principal-place source snapshot is acquired in stable registry-number and Socrata-row-ID order and hashed before normalization. Source metadata and selected-row/distinct-registration counts are rechecked before publication. A complete staged source snapshot can be revalidated and normalized into a new immutable run without reacquisition, and a complete unpublished manifest can be independently verified and published by immutable run ID. current.json changes only after complete run-scoped publication.
idempotency: The source rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release; the Oregon registry number creates one stable provisional organization or assumed-business-name brand candidate.
cancellation: Abort network requests and local record processing cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and approved public normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
